scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-timetracking "npm run test:emulator --workspaces --if-present"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @timetracking/functions
scripts.e2e:extension: npm run build:functions && npm run build:dev -w @timetracking/extension && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-timetracking "node extension/scripts/smoke.ts --e2e"
scripts.e2e:portal: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-timetracking "node portal/e2e/portal.e2e.ts"
